title: Hotels and shopping
can: Book a room, ask for what you need, say what you want and what you can do, and understand prices.
doneText: You can now ask for a room, point at what you want to buy, ask politely and pay.

discover.intro: Every sentence picks out one thing to buy. Spot what decides ce or cette.
discover.question: What decides ce or cette?
options: The noun. Ce goes with masculine nouns and cette with feminine ones, like un and une.
Whether you are in a shop or a hotel.
discover.nudge: Not quite. Think about un and une. Pull, sac and livre are masculine. Robe, veste and chambre are feminine.
discover.reveal: Ce means this or that. It changes with the noun, just like un and une. Ask politely with je voudrais, and use vouloir and pouvoir for wanting and being able:

learn.title: Vouloir, pouvoir and ce
learn.sub: Tap any form to hear it

blocks.text: Je veux means I want, and it sounds blunt, like a child asking. Je voudrais means I would like, and it is what you say to a stranger. In a shop or hotel, ask with je voudrais or vous avez ... ?

blocks.title: Je peux or je voudrais
a: Can I pay by card? (asking if it is allowed)
b: I'd like to pay by card. (saying what you want)
blocks.note: Je peux asks if something is allowed. Je voudrais says what you want. Both are polite. Vous pouvez is how you ask someone to do something: vous pouvez répéter ?

blocks.text: In a shop, an assistant will ask je peux vous aider ?, can I help you? If you want to look on your own, say je regarde, merci. Do not just ignore the question.
In a French hotel, breakfast is often not included in the room price. Ask le petit déjeuner est compris ? to check. Say bonjour when you walk up to the desk, even if the receptionist is busy.

phrases.es: Je voudrais une chambre pour deux nuits.
phrases.en: I'd like a room for two nights.
Have you got this in blue?

options: Can I have breakfast in my room?

items.why: On takes the same form as il: peut.

exercises.why: Je voudrais is the polite way to say I would like.

exercises.prompt: Tap the word that is wrong.
Tap the word that is wrong.
exercises.why: Je goes with peux. Peut goes with il, elle and on.
Vous avez ... ? is the everyday way to ask in a hotel or shop.
Je peux ... ? asks if something is allowed.

exercises.prompt: I would like a room for two nights.
exercises.answer: Je voudrais une chambre pour deux nuits.
exercises.why: Je voudrais, then what you want, then pour plus the number of nights.

exercises.prompt: A shop assistant asks: Je peux vous aider ? You only want to look. What do you say?
exercises.why: Je regarde, merci is the polite way to say you are just looking.

exercises.prompt: Which is the polite way to ask for a room?
exercises.why: Je veux sounds blunt. Je voudrais is polite.
Je prends ça is what you say when you have chosen.

write.title: Say it in your own words
write.task: You arrive at a hotel in Paris. Ask for a room for two nights and ask if breakfast is included.
write.starter: Bonjour, je voudrais…  Le petit déjeuner…
write.model: Bonjour, je voudrais une chambre pour deux nuits. Le petit déjeuner est compris ?
checklist: Je voudrais for a polite request
Pour plus the number of nights

boss.title: Checking in at a hotel in Paris
boss.persona: You are Monsieur Bernard, a receptionist at a small hotel in Paris. The learner is a guest who wants a room. Ask how many nights, give the price, and talk about breakfast and paying by card. Address the learner as vous. Keep every message to one short sentence.

turns.en: Good evening. Can I help you?
choices: Bonsoir. Vous avez une chambre, s'il vous plaît ?
Bonsoir. Je veux une chambre.
Je veux is blunt. Je voudrais or vous avez ... ? is more polite.
Bonsoir. Vous avez un chambre, s'il vous plaît ?
Chambre is feminine: une chambre.

turns.npc: Oui. C'est pour combien de nuits ?
choices: Pour deux nuits, s'il vous plaît.
Pour deux nuit, s'il vous plaît.
More than one night is plural: nuits.
En deux nuits, s'il vous plaît.
For a length of stay, say pour: pour deux nuits.

turns.npc: Très bien. C'est quatre-vingts euros la nuit.
turns.en: Fine. It's eighty euros a night.
choices: Quatre-vingts euros ? Le petit déjeuner est compris ?
Soixante euros ? Le petit déjeuner est compris ?
Soixante is 60. Quatre-vingts is 80.
Quatorze euros ? Le petit déjeuner est compris ?
Quatorze is 14. Quatre-vingts is 80.

turns.npc: Non, le petit déjeuner est à dix euros.
choices: D'accord. Je peux payer par carte ?
D'accord. Je peut payer par carte ?
Je goes with peux: je peux.
D'accord. Je voudrais payer par carte ?
Je voudrais says what you want. To ask if it is allowed, use je peux ?

boss.closingEn: Here is your key. Good night.
